remarks: Welcome to 68 Center Street - a rustic retreat nestled in beautiful Greens Farms. This character-rich 1920s Cottage, cherished by the same family for over 50 years, is now ready to begin a new chapter - with you. You will find charming nooks, thoughtful details and two wood burning fireplaces perfect for quiet mornings or hosting friends, on three finished levels. The glass solarium entry invites you to view a peaceful garden featuring an impressive collection of 37 different kinds of flowers. The eat-in kitchen sets the scene for leisurely weekend breakfasts, while both the living and family rooms - with their fireplaces - provide an inviting backdrop for cozy evenings. Outside, there's a charming detached stone garage, a whimsical potting shed and grounds that offer both privacy and serenity - without sacrificing convenience. You're close to local favorites - restaurants, markets, the Greens Farms train station, Burying Hill Beach, Greens Farms Elementary and Sherwood Island State Park - all just minutes away. 68 Center Street isn't just a home - it's a charming blank canvas waiting for your personal touch! Home and property sold "as is."
